Rashi on Pesachim 91a:10:1.english: You may not sacrifice the Paschal lamb in one of your gates - And [he] expounds "in one" by itself, [to mean] on behalf of an individual.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:10:2.english: And they are unable to eat it - An olive-bulk of it.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:11:1.hebrew: מנין לזובח פסחו בבמת יחיד - במה קטנה, שהיא בלא תעשה. להכי נקט במת יחיד ולא במת ציבור, דבמת ציבור בשעת איסור הבמות ליכא, דשעת איסור הבמות לאחר שנבחר משכן שילה, ומשחרב היה להם היתר עד שנבנה בית עולמים, ומשנבנה חזרו לאיסורם, ושוב לא היה להם היתר:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:11:1.english: From where [do we know] regarding one who sacrifices his Paschal lamb on a private altar - [This refers to] a small altar, [and asks from where we know] that it is [subject to] a negative prohibition. For this reason [the baraita] specifically stated a private altar and not a communal altar, because a communal altar does not exist during a time when altars are prohibited; for the time of the prohibition of altars [began] after the Tabernacle of Shiloh was chosen, and once it was destroyed, they were permitted until the Eternal House [the Temple] was built, and once it was built, they returned to their prohibited status, and never again were they permitted.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:11:2.hebrew: שהיא בלא תעשה - אבל כרת דשחוטי חוץ ליכא, ובשחיטת קדשים בפרק בתרא (זבחים דף קיד:) מוקי לה בקודם חצות, דמחוסר זמן הוא להתקבל בפנים, דכתיב: "אשר ישחט מחוץ למחנה ואל פתח אהל מועד לא הביאו" — הראוי לפתח אהל מועד חייב עליו, ושאינו ראוי לאהל מועד אינו חייב עליו. ויליף מהכא דמחוסר זמן בחוץ, אע"פ שאינו בכרת, בלא תעשה מיהא הוי, הואיל וראוי לבא לאחר זמן:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:11:2.english: That it is [a violation of] a negative [commandment] - However, there is no [liability for] karet for [offerings] slaughtered outside [the Temple]. And in [tractate] Shechitat Kodashim, in the final chapter (Zevachim 114b), [the Gemara] establishes this [case] as [referring to one who slaughters it] before midday, when it is premature to be accepted inside [the Temple], as it is written: "[Whoever] slaughters outside the camp, and to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he did not bring it" — [that which is] fit for the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, one is liable for it, and [that which is] not fit for the Tent of Meeting, one is not liable for it. And [the baraita] derives from here that [an offering whose] time has not yet arrived [that is slaughtered] outside, even though it is not [subject] to karet, is nevertheless [in violation of] a negative commandment, since it is fit to come [and be offered] after [its] time [arrives].

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:12:1.hebrew: יכול אף בשעת היתר הבמות כן - יהא בלא תעשה זה, דהא לא הותרה במת יחיד אלא לדבר הנידר ונידב, ולהוי האי לגביה כשעת איסור:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:12:1.english: I might [have thought] even at a time when improvised altars are permitted [it is] so - [that] it would be [subject to] this negative commandment, since a private improvised altar was permitted only for a vowed or freewill offering, and thus this [Paschal offering] would be, with respect to it, like a time of prohibition.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:12:2.hebrew: ת"ל כו' - דהאי לאו דהכא לא משתעי אלא בשעת איסור הבמות, והכי שמעינן ליה לקרא: לא תוכל לזבוח את הפסח בבמת יחיד בזמן שכל ישראל נכנסין בשער אחד כו', כי אם אל המקום אשר יבחר שם תזבחנו:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:12:2.english: The verse states, etc. - For this negative commandment here speaks only of a time when improvised altars are prohibited, and this is how we understand the verse: You may not slaughter the Paschal lamb on a private altar at a time when all of Israel enter into one gate, etc., rather, in the place that [He] will choose, there you shall slaughter it.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:14:1.hebrew: ופרכינן לר' יוסי ממאי דקרא לכדר' שמעון כו' - ולאו פירכא כולי האי, דאיכא למימר מר דריש ליה הכי ומר דריש ליה הכי. אלא טעמא דר' יוסי מהדר לפרושי מ"איש לפי אכלו":
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:14:1.english: And we ask: For Rabbi Yosei, from where [do we know] that the verse [comes] according to Rabbi Shimon, etc. - This is not so much a refutation, since one can say that one [Sage] expounds it this way and the other [Sage] expounds it that way; rather, [the Gemara] is seeking to explain Rabbi Yosei's reasoning from [the verse] "According to every man's eating."

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:14:2.hebrew: לא ס"ד - דלאסור פסח על היחיד אתא, דכתיב "איש לפי אכלו תכוסו" — על איש אחד תשחטו, ובלבד שיראה לאכילה:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:14:2.english: It cannot enter your mind - that it comes to prohibit [slaughtering] the Paschal lamb for an individual, for it is written: "According to each man's eating shall you count" — [meaning,] for one man you may slaughter [it], provided that he is fit to eat [it].

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:15:1.english: From Perishna - The name of a place.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:15:2.hebrew: אשה בראשון - חובה, ובשני רשות; ולקמיה יליף טעמייהו:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:15:2.english: A woman on the first [Pesach] - [it is] an obligation, and on the second [it is] optional; and later on, [the Gemara] derives their reasons.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:15:4.english: In any case, it teaches "by herself" - [in the] singular form.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:16:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr> לא, נשים ועבדים וקטנים:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:16:1.english: This is the reading: “No, women and slaves and minors.”

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:1:1.hebrew: והמפקח את הגל - מעל אדם, ואין ידוע אם ימצאנו חי או מת:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:1:1.english: And one clearing a pile - from over a person, and it is not known whether he will find him alive or dead.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:1:2.hebrew: שוחטין עליו - דמכ"מ עודנו בחזקת טהרה, ואונן נמי לאורתא חזי, כדאמרינן בגמרא דאנינות לילה ליתא מדאורייתא אלא אנינות יום, כדכתיב (ויקרא י׳:י״ט) "הן היום הקריבו" — יום אסור, לילה מותר בשחיטת קדשים; וגבי פסח לא העמידו דבריהם במקום כרת:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:1:2.english: One slaughters on his behalf - For in any case he is still in a presumptive state of ritual purity; and [even if he becomes] an onen [an acute mourner], he is also fit [to eat] in the evening, as we say in the Gemara that aninut of the night is not by Torah law, only aninut of the day, as it is written (Leviticus 10:19) "Behold, today they offered" — [by] day [it is] forbidden, [at] night [it is] permitted with regard to slaughtering sacrifices; and concerning the Paschal offering, [the Sages] did not uphold their decree in a case involving karet [excision].

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:1:3.english: One slaughters [the Paschal lamb] on their behalf - In a group of others.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:2:1.hebrew: שמא יביאוהו לידי פסול - שמא יטמא אונן למתו, ומפקח גל ימצאנו מת ונמצא שהאהיל על הטומאה, והחבוש שמא לא יצא, וחולה וזקן שמא יכבד חוליו ולא יוכל לאכול כזית:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:2:1.english: Perhaps they will bring it to disqualification - Perhaps an onen [an acute mourner] will become ritually impure through his dead [relative]; and one clearing a heap of rubble will find him dead, and it will turn out that he overshadowed the impurity; and the imprisoned [person] — perhaps he will not go out [of prison]; and a sick [person] and an elderly [person] — perhaps his illness will worsen and he will not be able to eat an olive-bulk.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:1.hebrew: לפיכך - הואיל ובשעת שחיטה ראויין היו ונזרק הדם עליהן, אם אירע בהן פסול, כמו שפירשתי, פטורין מלעשות פסח שני:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:1.english: Therefore - Since at the time of slaughter they were fit and the blood was sprinkled on their behalf, if a disqualification occurred to them, as I explained, they are exempt from observing the second Pesach.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:2.hebrew: חוץ מן המפקח את הגל - ונמצא המת תחתיו, שחייב לעשות פסח שני:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:2.english: Except for one who clears a pile [of debris] - and the corpse is found beneath it, [for] he is obligated to observe the second Pesach.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:3.hebrew: שהוא טמא מתחלתו - קודם שחיטה, שהרי האהיל על הטומאה משעה שהתחיל לפקח. ובגמרא מוקי לה בגל עגול, שמתחלה האהיל את כולו:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:3:3.english: Because he is ritually impure from the outset - Before the slaughter, for he overshadowed the ritual impurity from the moment he began to clear [the pile]. And in the Gemara, it establishes it [as referring] to a round pile, such that from the beginning he overshadowed all of it.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:4:1.english: They did not teach [this] - That one does not slaughter [the Paschal lamb] on behalf of a prisoner by himself.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:4:2.hebrew: בית האסורין של ישראל - כגון לכופו להוציא אשה פסולה או לשלם ממון, אי נמי כדתניא (כתובות דף לג:): אם יקום והתהלך בחוץ כו', וכי תעלה על דעתך זה מהלך בשוק וזה נהרג? אלא מלמד שחובשין אותו עד שנראה מה תהא עליו:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:4:2.english: A prison belonging to Jews - For example, to compel him to divorce a disqualified wife, or to pay money; or else as it was taught in a baraita (Ketubot 33b): "If he rises and walks outside, etc., would it enter your mind [that] this one walks in the marketplace while that one is put to death? Rather, it teaches that we imprison him until we see what will become of him."

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:5:1.english: Beit Pagei - An outer place in Jerusalem.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:5:2.hebrew: דמעיילי ליה - מן הפסח בתוך בית האסורין לאכול, דהא לפנים מירושלים הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:5:2.english: That they bring [it] in to him - [Some] of the Paschal [lamb] into the prison to eat, for it is within Jerusalem.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:6:1.hebrew: ל"ש - דמפקח גל חייב לעשות פסח שני, אלא גל עגול, דמתחלתו האהיל עליו. אבל גל ארוך — שמא בשעת שחיטה עדיין לא האהיל כנגד הטומאה. וכיון דספק יצא ספק לא יצא, פטור משום דלא אפשר, כדאמרן לעיל (פסחים דף פח:) גבי חמשה שנתערבו עורות פסחיהן:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:6:1.english: They taught only - [meaning] that one who clears a pile [of stones] is obligated to observe the second Pesach only [in the case of] a round pile, for from the beginning he overshadowed it. But [regarding] a long pile — perhaps at the time of slaughter he had not yet overshadowed opposite the impurity. And since it is uncertain [whether] he fulfilled [his obligation or] did not fulfill [his obligation], he is exempt because it is not possible [to do otherwise], as we said above (Pesachim 88b) regarding five [people] whose Paschal lambs' hides became mixed up.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:8:1.english: On behalf of an individual - The reason is derived in the Gemara.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:8:2.hebrew: ואפילו חבורה של מאה - רבי יוסי קאמר לה, כלומר: לא תליא מילתא דפסח אלא באכילה. יחיד ויכול לאכול כזית, שוחטין עליו; מאה ואין יכולין לאכול כזית בין כולם, אין שוחטין עליהן:
Rashi on Pesachim 91a:8:2.english: And even a group of one hundred - Rabbi Yosei says this, meaning: the matter of the Paschal lamb depends only on eating. [If there is] an individual who is able to eat an olive-bulk, we slaughter [it] on his behalf; [if there are] one hundred who are unable to eat an olive-bulk among all of them, we do not slaughter [it] on their behalf.

Rashi on Pesachim 91a:9:1.english: And we do not make a group of women, slaves, and minors - The reason is explained in the Gemara.

Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:10:1.hebrew: עשרה ואין יכולין לאוכלו אין שוחטין עליהן - בהא מודה אפילו ר' יהודה, כדתנן: שלא יביאוהו לידי פסול:
Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:10:1.english: Ten, and they are unable to eat it, we do not slaughter [it] on their behalf - In this [case] even Rabbi Yehuda agrees, as we learned in the Mishnah, so that they do not bring it to [a state of] disqualification.

Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:11:1.english: What does he do with this [phrase] "in any one" - [The Gemara] could have said that it is needed for what we say in [the chapter] Keitzad Tzolin (above, Pesachim 79b), that an individual does not tip the balance [of the community toward impurity].

Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:16:1.hebrew: והתנן אין עושין חבורת נשים - מעיקרא, דקתני "בפני עצמה", לא קשיא ליה, אלא השתא דקאמר "אימא בפני עצמן" — משום דמשמע ליה דלא אסרה מתניתין חבורת נשים אלא כשיש נשים הרבה, שסומכות זו על זו ואינן זהירין לשמור הפסח ומביאות אותו לידי פסול; אבל יחידה, שוחטין עליה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:16:1.english: "And didn't we learn [in the Mishnah]: We do not make a group of women" - Initially, when [the baraita] taught "by herself," it did not pose a difficulty for him, only now that [Rava] says, "Say: by themselves" — because it seemed to him that the Mishnah only prohibited a group of women when there are many women, since they rely on one another and are not careful to guard the Paschal lamb and bring it to disqualification; whereas for a single [woman], one may slaughter [it] on her behalf.

Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:3:1.hebrew: שהיה טמא מתחלתו - תימה לר"י: מפקח הגל נמי, נימא חי הוה כשהתחיל לפקח? וי"ל, דכיון דמצאו מת, אית לן למימר שמתחלתו היה מת, שכל הטומאות כשעת מציאתן:
Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:3:1.english: "That he was ritually impure from the outset" - It is astonishing to R' Yitzchak: [regarding] one who clears a pile [of stones] as well, why not say [that the buried person] was alive when he began to clear [it]? And one can answer that since he found him dead, we must say that he was dead from the outset, for all [cases of] ritual impurity are [judged] as of the time of their discovery.

Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:4:1.hebrew: לא שנו אלא בבית האסורין של עכו"ם - בירושלמי מוקי לה רבי יוסי בר בון בשם רבי יוחנן: כשחבשוהו ישראל, אבל חבשוהו עכו"ם — אין שוחטין עליו אפי' עם אחרים, "אשר פיהם דבר שוא", והיינו איפכא משמעתין:
Tosafot on Pesachim 91a:4:1.english: They taught [this] only regarding a prison of gentiles - In the Yerushalmi, Rabbi Yosei bar Bun establishes it in the name of Rabbi Yoḥanan [as referring to] when Jews imprisoned him; but [if] gentiles imprisoned him, one does not slaughter on his behalf even with others, [as it is written,] "whose mouth speaks falsehood" — and this is the opposite of our sugya.
